name: Mujintou Monogatari 4
source:
A plane crashes into the sea, but the protagonist survives and reaches a seemingly deserted island. He teams up with other survivors and explores the island. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一架飛機墜入海中，但主角倖存了下來，到達了一座看似無人的島嶼。他與其他倖存者組隊，探索這座島嶼。

［出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-july-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]］
